milestones.title: Sprint 0 — Repository Foundation · v0.2.0
milestones.description: Repository identity, governance, planning metadata, and operational GitHub configuration.

milestones.title: Sprint 1 — Audit Core · v0.3.0
milestones.description: Modular read-only audit core and normalized provider contract.

milestones.title: Sprint 2 — Runtime & SDK Detection · v0.4.0
milestones.description: Complete runtime, SDK, package-manager, and developer CLI detection.

milestones.title: Sprint 3 — PATH & Environment Intelligence · v0.5.0
milestones.description: PATH resolution, environment-variable health, and command-precedence intelligence.

milestones.title: Sprint 4 — Project & Git Discovery · v0.6.0
milestones.description: Local project discovery plus Git repository and worktree hygiene detection.

milestones.title: Sprint 5 — Version Intelligence · v0.7.0
milestones.description: Installed-versus-current version intelligence with ecosystem-aware channels.

milestones.title: Sprint 6 — Cross-PC Comparison · v0.8.0
milestones.description: Schema-aware comparison between workstation audit reports.

milestones.title: Sprint 7 — Audit Hardening · v0.9.0
milestones.description: Schemas, tests, static analysis, fixtures, CI, and audit reliability hardening.

milestones.title: Sprint 8 — Baseline Ready · v1.0.0
milestones.description: Complete trusted read-only audit ready for the first authoritative workstation baseline.
